name: noir-webtoon
title: Noir webtoon (experimental)
prompt_block: Single comic panel, moody noir webtoon illustration: deep shadows, limited teal and amber palette, clean digital line art, cinematic lighting.
negative_block: No text, letters, words, numbers, speech bubbles, captions or logos anywhere. No watermark. No extra characters beyond those named.
staging_rules: Keep the top 25 percent of the frame as uncluttered background (wall, ceiling or sky) for speech balloons added later.
licence: Prompt text: MIT (this repo). Reference sheets: generated for this project with the owner's image account; fictional characters only.
world: a rain-slick city at night: a cramped office, a fire escape, a wet street under one buzzing streetlight
composition: Tight, low-key framing: one strong light source, long shadows, faces half in dark.
impact: Full-bleed impact frame: a single hard flash of light cutting the dark, the moment frozen in silhouette.
